review_rules: source_visible false is metadata, not evidence of a missing or hidden reader control.
A runtime URL demonstrates link selection in code, not HTTP availability nor exact anchor correctness.
A source marked VERIFIED_PRIMARY in inherited corpus is not proof that all displayed EN, FR and LA text was independently collated.
For edition-specific forms (Roman Missal, Loreto, Saint Joseph), prefer the explicit reader edition witness and disclose historical/current distinctions.
Do not label full quotation certifiable until exact edition, original text, full language collation and target locator are individually verified.
